localChanges: The map on the city screen draws fog at its edges only where the squares beyond are unexplored, and its coasts and terrain at the edges now join the squares beyond as the main map's do (closes #685).
A city building a spaceship part shows one Buy button, not two at the same price (closes #713).

log: civ1-treasury prices a Wonder or a spaceship part at 4r, doubled with no shields stored, alongside every other buy price. These rules priced parts again, at the same prices, so a city building a part was sent two SpendCosts and showed two Buy buttons (civ-clone/web-renderer#713).
base-city-yield-gold is no longer used, and core-treasury only by the new test.
fix: drop the Spend rules for parts, which civ1-treasury already prices

civ1-treasury prices spaceship parts with every other buy price, so the test's ruleset no longer needs civ1-spaceship's copy, and once that file is gone this import would stop the suite loading (civ-clone/web-renderer#713).
test: stop registering civ1-spaceship's Spend rules
